protocol.policy: Score every original YOLO candidate with each verifier; output the highest detector_score*verifier_score if at least the previously frozen threshold0.01. No teacher/test label enters candidate ranking. Frozen original verifier is a numerical control.
protocol.weights_selection: Replay-trained heads/checkpoints selected only on original plus teacher development criteria, before this candidate reranking test.
protocol.scope: Post-test exploratory comparison on the150already opened sparse samples. No threshold search and no automatic deployment.
